tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Every live UK current-account switching offer Pocketly holds: what it pays and what Pocketly counts, each condition with the bank’s own words, who can’t get it, and when it was last checked.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One offer by its id (from list_offers or its pocketly.co.uk/offers/<id> address).

tools.name: check_offers
tools.description: Pocketly’s quick check: which offers fit a situation and the order that pays most, with dates and what is left after costs. The same planner and answer as pocketly.co.uk/check. Amounts in pounds. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: list_savings_and_cashback
tools.description: Savers and cashback from banks’ own pages, never counted in a plan: each with the most it pays by its own terms (or per £1,000 for easy-access savers), in the bank’s words.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Every offer edition Pocketly has published, newest first.
